plan.summary: BRO-5866: Safe House (Theatre Row, 2026) was mapped to the Show Score page of a different play, Enda Walsh's Safe House at St. Ann's Warehouse (2025), and carried its audience score. A corpus sweep by page review dates found 74 shows with Show Score data from another production. The public mappings and critic data were cleaned in the PR; this plan removes the matching audience scores from the private audience-buzz.json, corrects the Exeunt review's wrong-production reason, and deletes 15 off-topic search hits filed under Fire Fire. It also re-excludes a 2018 Broadway Cursed Child review filed under the 2026 West End one-part run.
steps: Remove the Show Score audience score that came from another production's page from audience-buzz.json (33 shows, Safe House included; combinedScore recomputed, showScore tombstoned). The public mapping and show-score.json part landed in the BRO-5866 PR, recorded under _productionMismatch.
Already excluded as wrongProduction; the reason was wrong. It is the Feb 2025 review of Enda Walsh's Safe House at St. Ann's Warehouse, a different play from the 2026 Theatre Row Safe House.

Found by validate-data (wrong-production-by-date) during BRO-5866: the 2018-04-30 Front Row Center review of the Broadway Cursed Child sits under the 2026 West End one-part run. A dateless-revival reason lets the rebuild release the hold now that the date is known, so it flipped twice on 2026-10-21; a manual reason stops that.
Exclude it: the review is dated 2018-04-30, 3084 days before this production's first date (2026-10-09).
